content.what_it_is: Top-level MATLAB spectrum-generation driver. It clears state, invokes Get_Inputs and reloads the resulting inputs.mat (L1-L3), creates a zero-coherence spectrum (L4-L6), optionally replaces frequency/energy/height/repetition/directional-weight outputs using Coherence_Spectrum (L7-L11), plots the 2-D spectrum, and writes the spectrum through Write_to_file (L12-L34). Several alternative plots are present only as comments (L16-L30).
entities: workspace configuration variables introduced by load inputs.mat at L3
idx_theta, freq_resolution, freq, theta, Spectrum_Energy, Hmo_each, reps, AG, and host_freqs_idx defined by Zero_Coherence_Spectrum at L5-L6
freq, Spectrum_Energy, Hmo_each, reps, and AG conditionally reassigned by Coherence_Spectrum at L9-L10
calls: clear, clc, and close all at L1
unresolved: Configuration side-effect/interface coupling at L3: every run first regenerates and overwrites inputs.mat through Get_Inputs, then loads unscoped variables from it. Configuration is neither passed explicitly nor returned, and the current working directory determines both producer and consumer file resolution.

The default Get_Inputs configuration read in the preceding gate chunk sets Coherent_Percentage=100, so L8 always enters Coherence_Spectrum; its unbounded random pool-selection failure modes are on the default execution path, not an optional edge case.

Reproducibility defect across L1-L10: the workflow clears state but never seeds or records MATLAB's random generator before Coherence_Spectrum randomly selects guests, so identical inputs can produce different freq/reps and output files.

Cross-function contract gap at L5-L10: idx_theta is produced and passed to Coherence_Spectrum but that function never uses it; other returned arrays are conditionally overwritten while freq_resolution and theta remain from Zero_Coherence_Spectrum, with no post-call length/energy consistency validation.
The driver never checks finiteness, target Hmo conservation, array lengths against mfreq/mtheta, or output status before Plot_2D and Write_to_file at L14 and L33-L34.
